physical_instances.rule: Assign new non-empty instance IDs after every reprint or geometry-changing rework. Sampling records are grouped by these IDs plus artifact hashes; old physical instances must never be silently pooled.

fixture_frame_definition.origin: M10 socket CAD center projected onto the fixture top datum
fixture_frame_definition.x_axis: unit vector from M10 socket center toward M12 socket center
fixture_frame_definition.z_axis: fitted upward normal of the fixture top datum
fixture_frame_definition.y_axis: z cross x, followed by orthonormalization
fixture_frame_definition.photo_mapping: The current front photo is left-to-right M12/M10/M8, so image horizontal u equals -fixture x.

measured_world_from_fixture.rotation_matrix_convention: 3x3 active rotation mapping fixture-frame vectors into WORLD; columns are measured X_F, Y_F, Z_F axes expressed in WORLD
measured_world_from_fixture.upright_tcp_matrix_rule: Measured post-install upright TCP rotation, not a nominal matrix. The live captured KUKA ABC rotation must remain within the stated SO(3) distance, and registered +TCP-Z must oppose +Z_F.

evidence.notes: Fill only from post-print/post-install metrology, including the physical M12 top-to-bottom depth and bottom datum. Do not copy nominal CAD values into measured fields.

authorization.rule: Sampling additionally requires the sampling script's own low-load gates. Full-loop motion also requires per-size tool clocking, tip height, runout and low-load requalification in real_tooling_v1.json.

claim_boundary: This file is a commissioning template, not evidence. Until measured fields and authorization are completed, software must fail closed before KST connection.
